# @three-ws/agenc-mcp

> The AgenC agent-to-agent coordination surface over MCP — browse the on-chain task marketplace, query the agent registry (ERC-8004-style identity), resolve three.ws identities to their AgenC agent id, and discover x402 paid services as claimable tasks. Read-first over the live public three.ws bridge. No key, no signer, no payment.

@three-ws/agenc-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/agenc-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agenc-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/agenc-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agenc-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agenc-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
